_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/ledger/test_times_tapped_this_turn.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. t_ttt_captain is Captain America, Living Legend's second sentence on a {G} 1/1, so a Llanowar Elves can pay for it. Llanowar Elves comes from data/cards, the bear from testing.cards.json.

cards.name: Test First-Tap Captain
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control becomes tapped during your turn, if it's the first time that creature has become tapped this turn, untap it.
